counterfactual.change: removed the single W detector_fail event (events: [detector_fail W t636 dur210] -> []) leaving all other fields identical; with normal detector visibility the actuated max_green/recall cycles resume and the 804-step run no longer violates max_wait

explanation: Actuated control with detector_fail on W (t=636 dur 210) causes EW green that began at ~608 to be held indefinitely. EW green is still active at 636, 674, 700 and 804. Max_green is 66s so it should have ended by ~674, but it persists for ~196s to the end. With EW holding green, NS (N,S) remains red with growing queues and wait accumulates to 201s >200 at step 804. Removing the single detector_fail restores normal cycling (max_green/recall enforced) and the same 804-step run has no violation, confirming the detector_fail-actuated interaction as cause.

violation.detail: approach 0 has waited 201 s at red with vehicles queued (limit 200)

vision_note: Across frames 801-804 the red violating vehicle remains stationary queued at the NS approach stop line and never advances into the intersection. Four consecutive seconds with no NS discharge while queued shows a prolonged red hold consistent with EW holding green indefinitely.
